review:
A black-and-white, all-scatter coin game hosted by Boney Bill. Wicked Grin symbols can reveal multipliers up to 20x for coins, and Diamond Coins can reveal values up to 500x.

Expanding at least one FS or Super FS symbol triggers one of two bonuses, with the Super version the stronger. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max, RTP versions from 96.27% down to 86.28%. The monochrome look really stands out. Great for coin-collecting fans.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
